advancement_trigger: P-01 through P-10, the package checker and security scans pass; advance only when an isolated real PostgreSQL environment also supplies required Auth/TLS, context-spoofing, two-process and live rollback artifacts.
stop_rule: Stop before traffic cutover if a unique constraint cannot preserve the original turn/binding/commit identity, a CAS conflict can be mistaken for success, or disabling the gate can admit a new turn after the close point.
